# dsh-github-mirror
A GitHub repository launcher panel for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI. It puts a GitHub entry in the s
idebar, lists your repositories, and opens them through a configurable mirror instead of `github.com
ebar, lists your repositories, and opens them through a configurable mirror instead of `github.com`.
中文说明
## Features

- **Sidebar panel** — a GitHub icon in the DSH sidebar opens the repository browser.
- **Repository
list** — reads up to 100 recently updated repositories and shows description, language, stars, updat

e time, and private/fork/archived badges.
- **Mirror browsing** — repository links are rewritten to
the selected mirror (`bgithub.xyz` by default). Also supports `gitclone.com`, official GitHub, or a

custom mirror.
- **Mirror health check** — when the panel opens, it probes the selected browse mirro
r once. If the mirror is unreachable, links temporarily fall back to official GitHub and a banner ex

plains what happened.
- **Accelerated clone/download** — `git clone` commands and zip downloads use

a separate route (`ghfast.top` by default, `gh-proxy.com`, `gitclone.com`, or official).
- **Quick o
pen** — paste `owner/repo`, `https://github.com/owner/repo`, `git@github.com:owner/repo.git`, or a m

irror URL into the search box and press Enter.
- **Optional private repositories** — a read-only per
sonal access token enables `/user/repos`, including private and organization repositories, and raise

s the API limit from 60 to 5,000 requests per hour.
- **Offline cache** — the last successful list i
s cached for 6 hours and remains visible when a refresh fails.
## Requirements

- A DSH build with client plugin support (tested with `0.2.1-rc.2`).
- Network access to `api.github
.com`. If it is blocked, the panel automatically tries the `gh-proxy.com` API mirror for unauthentic

ated requests.
- No build step: `client.js` is the browser bundle.

## Usage

1. Click the GitHub icon in the DSH sidebar.
2. Enter a GitHub username on first use. Only a usernam

e is needed; do not paste an email or a full URL.
3. Public repositories work without logging in. Fo

r private repositories, open the gear menu and add a token with `repo` read access.
4. Use the two r

oute selectors at the top of the panel:
- **Browse via** rewrites repository and profile links.
- **

Clone / download** rewrites `git clone` and zip URLs.
5. Each repository row has three actions: copy
clone command, download the default branch zip, and open in the selected mirror.
The username, routes, and cache are stored in the browser. The token is session-only unless **Rememb
er the token** is checked.
## Routes
| Route | Used for | Notes |

| `bgithub.xyz` | Browse | GitHub-style web mirror; availability varies |
| `gitclone.com` | Browse

/ Git | Web mirror and clone acceleration |
| `ghfast.top` | Clone / downloads | Proxies `github.com

` and `raw.githubusercontent.com` |
| `gh-proxy.com` | Clone / downloads / API | Also used as the un

authenticated API fallback |
| Official GitHub | Fallback | Direct connection |
Mirrors are third-party services and can change or disappear. Every route is selectable at runtime,
and the settings dialog accepts custom mirror and acceleration prefixes, so no code change is needed
when a mirror goes down.
## Privacy and security

- The username, route choices, and repository cache live in `localStorage`.
- The token is kept in `
sessionStorage` by default and is written to `localStorage` only when **Remember the token** is enab

led.
- The token is sent only to `https://api.github.com`. It is never forwarded to `gh-proxy.com` o

r any other mirror.
- The cache can contain private repository names and descriptions. **Clear local

settings** removes it.
- The plugin opens links in the system browser; it does not proxy git traffi
c or store repositories locally.
## Limitations

- Only the first 100 repositories are read (sorted by recent update); there is no pagination yet.
-
Without a token, `/users/:name/repos` returns public repositories owned by that account. Organizatio

n and collaborator repositories require a token and `/user/repos`.
- A mirror page is only as fresh

as the mirror; it may lag behind GitHub.
- Fetched repository data comes from the GitHub REST API. T
he panel is a launcher, not a full GitHub client.
